text: HRW's World Report 2026 China chapter states that 'The Chinese government has since late 2016 committed a range of crimes against humanity in Xinjiang' and that 'Human rights defenders in China are frequently harassed, tortured, and imprisoned'.
short: China: crimes against humanity in Xinjiang; defenders harassed, tortured, imprisoned (HRW 2026)

source.name: Human Rights Watch - World Report 2026, China
